text: dsh-web-search-glm 是一个 DSH 搜索提供方插件，将智谱 GLM 的原生 web_search 接入 DSH 的 web seam。它向 Anthropic-compatible Messages API 发送查询，并把 GLM 返回的搜索结果映射为统一来源。它支持解析 Python repr 与 JSON 结果、合并多次搜索并按 URL 去重，也支持凭据引用、可配置模型和搜索次数上限。适合希望用智谱 GLM 为 DSH 增加联网资料检索的用户。使用时需要可用的 GLM API key。

dsh-web-search-glm connects Zhipu GLM's native web search to DSH's web seam. It sends queries to the Messages API and normalizes returned sources, including Python repr and JSON payloads. Searches can be merged and deduplicated by URL. A GLM API key is required.
想让 DSH 能通过智谱 GLM 联网搜索资料。
有没有办法把 GLM 搜索接进 DSH 的 web 能力？
我想用智谱的网页搜索结果作为 DSH 的资料来源。
让 DSH 调用原生 web_search 并返回可引用的网页来源。
I want DSH to search the web using Zhipu GLM.
Can I use GLM's native web search as my DSH research provider?
dsh-web-search-glm 的功能「GLM 联网搜索」：把用户查询发送到 GLM Messages API，并启用原生 web_search 工具。每次请求可限制工具调用次数，返回搜索响应供 DSH 使用。
dsh-web-search-glm 的功能「结果标准化」：将 GLM 的 server_tool_use 与 tool_result 配对，把标题、链接和摘要整理成统一搜索来源，并按 URL 去重。
dsh-web-search-glm 的功能「凭据与端点配置」：每次搜索解析 API key，可从凭据服务或启动环境获取；baseURL 也能使用 GLM_SEARCH_BASE_URL 环境回退值。
dsh-web-search-glm 的功能「取消搜索」：请求支持 AbortSignal；搜索期间取消时会以 WEB_ABORTED 错误结束，方便调用方中止等待。
dsh-web-search-glm 使用搜索时会把查询内容发送至配置的 GLM Anthropic-compatible API，默认主机为 open.bigmodel.cn；需要提供可解析的 GLM API key。
DSH 搜索想切换到 GLM 提供的网页检索服务。
I need search results from GLM available through the DSH web provider interface.

dsh-web-search-glm README · dsh-web-search-glm：Zhipu GLM-backed search provider for the dsh (`ctx.web`) seam. It executes the native `web_search_20250305` server tool through GLM's Anthropic-compatible endpoint and maps GLM's `web_search_prime` result blocks to normalized search sources.

dsh-web-search-glm README · How it works：The outgoing request is shaped exactly like the official `@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-search-deepseek` provider's: `POST {baseURL}/messages` carrying the `web_search_20250305` server tool (bounded by `max_uses`), the `anthropic-version` header, `redirect: "error"`, and full `AbortSignal` support.

The difference is entirely in the response mapping. Instead of Anthropic-standard `web_search_tool_result` blocks, GLM returns its own pair of blocks:

dsh-web-search-glm README · How it works：- `server_tool_use` blocks named `web_search_prime`, paired with
- `tool_result` blocks whose `content` is a stringified Python-repr list of search results.

The provider pairs `server_tool_use` with `tool_result` by id (multiple searches in one response are merged), parses the content (`JSON.parse` first, then a small hand-written Python-repr tokenizer), maps each `{title, link, content}` entry to `{url, title, snippet}`, and dedupes by `url`.

dsh-web-search-glm README · How it works：If the response contains no usable structured search results, the search fails with `WEB_PROVIDER_ERROR` — there is no scraping or prose fallback, matching the official provider's semantics. On non-2xx responses the server-side error message is passed through verbatim (still `WEB_PROVIDER_ERROR`). Other codes: `WEB_PROVIDER_CREDENTIAL_MISSING` when no API key resolves, `WEB_ABORTED` on cancellation.

dsh-web-search-glm README · How it works：Observed endpoint behavior (live test, 2026-08-27): GLM does not reject nonsense queries — it still executes the web search and returns ~10 sources, so the "no results" branch is rarely taken; this is endpoint behavior, not something the provider configures. Searches on this endpoint were billed under the GLM Coding Plan, like chat traffic.

dsh-web-search-glm README · Install：From the dsh plugin marketplace (once the package is listed):

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add dsh-web-search-glm
```

Or from a local checkout:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add /path/to/dsh-web-search-glm
```

dsh-web-search-glm README · Install：**Either way, you must explicitly select the provider.** `dsh-web` reads its selection from the `web` row's config — the `dsh-base` bundle pins `deepseek-official`, and a `web:` section in `~/.dsh/settings.yaml` has no effect there. Override it in your profile's own patch layer, `~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/cordis.patch.yml` (applied after every bundle layer):

```yaml

dsh-web-search-glm README · ~/.dsh/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml：- id: web
  config:
    searchProvider: glm
```

A patch replaces the targeted row's whole `config` — restate every key the base row owns (today just `searchProvider`).

Exporting `DSH_WEB_SEARCH_PROVIDER=glm` in the launching environment works too.

Without this, if the official `@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-search-deepseek` provider is also installed and available, more than one search provider is simultaneously `available()` and dsh-web throws `WEB_PROVIDER_AMBIGUOUS` rather than guessing.

dsh-web-search-glm README · Configuration：| Key | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `apiKey` | — | Literal API key (secret). Prefer the `apiKeyEnv` credential reference. |
| `apiKeyEnv` | `ZAI_API_KEY` | Credential reference name. Keep it in sync with the `apiKeyEnv` of the `zai` provider in your dsh settings so both read one stored key. |
| `baseURL` | `https://open.bigmodel.cn/api/anthropic/v1` | Anthropic-compatible endpoint; `/messages` is appended by the provider. The overseas deployment can point to `https://api.z.ai/api/anthropic/v1`. |
| `model` | `glm-5.3` | Model that executes the native web search. Verified live — see [Model notes](#model-notes). |
| `apiVersion` | `2023-06-01` | Value of the `anthropic-version` header. |
| `maxTokens` | `4096` | Upper bound on generated tokens for the Messages request. |
| `maxUses` | `5` | Maximum `web_search` server-tool uses per request. |

dsh-web-search-glm README · Configuration：Example:

```yaml

dsh-web-search-glm README · profile patch, see Install):：web-search-glm:
  apiKeyEnv: ZAI_API_KEY
  # baseURL: https://api.z.ai/api/anthropic/v1   # overseas endpoint
  # model: glm-5.3-flash                         # verified alternative, see Model notes
```

dsh-web-search-glm README · profile patch, see Install):：**Credential resolution chain.** The key is resolved per search, in order: a literal `apiKey` set in the `web-search-glm` section → the credentials service via the `apiKeyEnv` reference → a launch-environment variable of the same name. If nothing resolves, the search fails with `WEB_PROVIDER_CREDENTIAL_MISSING`.

dsh-web-search-glm README · profile patch, see Install):：**Endpoint environment fallback.** If the `web-search-glm` section does not set `baseURL`, the launching environment's `GLM_SEARCH_BASE_URL` is consulted before the built-in default. The variable is deliberately distinct from any chat-completions base-URL variable — search speaks the Anthropic-compatible Messages API under its own address (mirroring upstream `DEEPSEEK_SEARCH_BASE_URL`).

dsh-web-search-glm README · Model notes：- `glm-5.3` (default) — verified live on 2026-08-27: english and chinese queries each returned 10 sources through the native web search.
- `glm-5.3-flash` — verified live on 2026-08-27: all four smoke cases (english / chinese / nonsense / bad-key) behaved identically to `glm-5.3`, with real searches executed (english and chinese each returned 10 sources). A working alternative — set `model: glm-5.3-flash` to use it.
- `glm-5-flash` — does not exist on this endpoint. Every request is rejected by the server with `[1214][modelCode：不存在]` (surfaced as `WEB_PROVIDER_ERROR`). Do not use this name.
dsh-web-search-glm README · Model notes：The package default stays `glm-5.3`; it is not changed merely because the flash variant is available.

dsh-web-search-glm README · Compatibility：- Targets the dsh plugin seam protocol of `dsh >= 0.1.1-rc.2` (peer dependencies `@deepseek-ai/dsh-*` `^0.1.1-rc.2`).
- MIT License — see [LICENSE](LICENSE).

dsh-web-search-glm README · Development：- `npm test` — parser unit tests on the built-in `node:test` runner; no extra dev dependencies. Fixtures are real captured GLM responses under `test/fixtures/`.
- `npm run capture` — one-off live capture that refreshes `test/fixtures/` (`scripts/capture.mjs`). Needs `ZAI_API_KEY` (falls back to `ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN`).
- `npm run smoke` — live-endpoint smoke run of four cases (english / chinese / nonsense / bad-key): `node scripts/smoke.mjs [model]`. Needs `ZAI_API_KEY` (falls back to `ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN`).

dsh-web-search-glm README · Development：The live scripts intentionally live in `scripts/`, not `test/` — Node 26's `node --test` auto-discovery would execute them during `npm test` — and they are not shipped in the published npm package.
